items.summary: Add a 'Machines Available on Rent' section to the HomePage that highlights rental availability for agricultural machines. This should include a visually distinct card or banner with a heading like 'Machines Available on Rent', a short description, and a call-to-action to contact for rental inquiries.

Add a 'Home Delivery Available' badge or highlight across relevant pages (HomePage hero section, ProductCatalogPage, and Footer). Use a recognizable delivery icon and short text such as 'Home Delivery Available' to make it prominent.

Add an 'Authorized Dealer of Srachi in Kashmir Province' highlight to the HomePage hero section and the BusinessProfilePage. Display it as a prominent badge or trust seal, using text: 'Authorized Dealer – Srachi, Kashmir Province'.

Update the ProductCard component to display a 'Available for Rent' badge alongside or below the existing price/availability info when a product supports rental. If the backend does not currently support a rental flag on products, display the general rental availability note on all product cards.
